name: EDLR 6054
title: Inquiry and Research in Educational Leadership I: Foundations, Design, and Use
description: Explicates knowledge production through systematic inquiry in education, including processes, questions, and strategies used to conduct meaningful research in schools. Explores the intersection of theory and practice with emphasis placed on the critical analysis and interpretation of the research literature to the practice of school leadership.
requirement_description: Open to students in the Ed.D. program in Educational Leadership.
